name: Paytm
tagline: Listed payments-plus-credit super app rebuilding after its bank's collapse
facts: FY26 PAT ₹552 cr, first full-year profit
Vijay Shekhar Sharma, MD and CEO
PPBL licence cancelled Apr 2026; PA licence Nov 2025

strategy.label: Mission
strategy.text: Bring half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy through payments and financial services.

strategy.label: Vision
strategy.text: Be India's AI-first financial super app: payments as the hook, merchant devices and credit as the profit engine.

strategy.label: Super-app lesson
strategy.text: Shrank from everything-app (ticketing sold to Zomato 2024, PPBL shut) to a focused payments-plus-finance super app.

strategy.label: Moat
strategy.text: Soundbox and card-machine base with crores of merchants, brand recall, and full PA licences regained 2025.

strategy.label: Key bets
strategy.text: Merchant and personal loan distribution (+45% YoY), Postpaid credit on UPI, AI app with Perplexity, AI soundboxes.

strategy.label: Your view
strategy.text: Is Paytm's future a super app, or a merchant-payments-and-credit company that also has a consumer app?

customers.who: Kiranas, shops with Soundbox and POS
customers.pain: Need instant payment confirmation and working capital
customers.why: Soundbox audio alerts, card machines, merchant loans on transaction history

customers.pain: Need reliable gateway and high success rates
customers.why: Paytm Payment Gateway back after RBI PA licence; bundled with lending

customers.who: UPI users, Tier 2+, long-time wallet users
customers.pain: Want payments, bills, travel and offers in one place
customers.why: Familiar brand, cashback, bills, travel, gold, UPI Lite in one app

customers.pain: Small-ticket credit hard to get from banks
customers.why: Personal loans and Postpaid credit on UPI via partner lenders

customers.pain: Need low-cost digital customer acquisition and collections
customers.why: Paytm sources, underwrites with data, and supports collections; paid per disbursal

portfolio.guardrails: Partner portfolio NPAs, FLDG exposure, RBI digital lending compliance

products.desc: Perplexity-powered search and money insights in app

products.name: AI Soundbox
products.desc: Merchant insights, translation, business agent features

portfolio.north_star: Weekly active users using two or more services
portfolio.key_metrics: Cross-category usage, AI query engagement, travel GMV
portfolio.guardrails: App clutter, contribution margin per category, marketing spend

rows.how: Soundbox subscriptions, card/PG MDR; Q1 FY27 ₹1,384 cr (+33%)
Sourcing and collection fees; Q1 FY27 ₹814 cr (+45%)
Small platform fees on some recharges and card bills

bullets.label: Revenue mix
bullets.text: Q1 FY27: payments ~57%, financial services ~33%, rest marketing; lending is the fastest-growing line.

bullets.label: Users vs payers
bullets.text: Consumers mostly pay nothing; merchants pay for devices, lenders pay for distribution.

bullets.label: Unit economics
bullets.text: EBITDA margin 8% Q1 FY27 versus FY25 loss of ₹1,506 cr; marketing and ESOP costs cut.

bullets.label: Growth levers
bullets.text: Device merchant base, credit distribution, gateway licence restored, UPI MDR for large merchants, AI upsell.

bullets.label: Lesson
bullets.text: Regulatory trust is a product feature: PPBL compliance failures erased wallet and bank businesses.

friction: Brand trust damaged by Payments Bank shutdown
Cluttered home screen from super-app legacy
Wallet and FASTag migration confused existing users
Aggressive loan and offer pushes in app
Support slow for failed transactions and refunds

competitors.label: Consumer UPI
competitors.text: PhonePe, Google Pay, Navi, super.money, WhatsApp Pay

competitors.label: Merchant devices
competitors.text: PhonePe SmartSpeaker, BharatPe, Pine Labs, Razorpay POS

competitors.label: Lending
competitors.text: PhonePe, Bajaj Finserv, Navi, KreditBee, bank apps

competitors.label: Super app
competitors.text: Tata Neu, Jio Financial, Amazon Pay, MakeMyTrip

competitors.label: Edge
competitors.text: Profitable, listed, largest device-merchant base, full PA licences

competitors.label: Risk
competitors.text: RBI scrutiny history, partner-lending credit cycles, UPI share stuck ~8%

news.label: Jul 2026
news.text: Q1 FY27: revenue +28% to ₹2,448 cr, record EBITDA ₹203 cr.

news.label: May 2026
news.text: First full-year profit: FY26 PAT ₹552 cr on ₹8,437 cr revenue.

news.label: Apr 2026
news.text: RBI cancelled Paytm Payments Bank licence citing governance lapses.

news.label: Watch
news.text: UPI MDR rules, Postpaid scale-up, 30% cap reshuffling UPI share.

sources: One97 Communications shareholder letters FY26 and Q1 FY27, RBI and NPCI data, press coverage 2024–26. Metrics are PM estimates for interview prep. Prepared Oct 2026.
